controls.before_training: same actual randomly initialized model and each arm's own inputs
controls.single_modality: same architecture, targets, initial seed,20steps and parameter-example update count; differing raw information
controls.train_target_mean: training-target centroid repeated as prediction; no SGD or raw input, cheaper and not compute matched

cost_scope: actual model forwards and parameter-example updates; tensors and gradients; excludes backend operations, activations and allocator peak
evaluation_boundary: COCO2017 validation photos/captions, 8 per role, exploratory reuse; no fresh blind, temporal, OOD or cross-task claim
grouping: original image and its canonical source caption form one group; all five roles disjoint
inference_scope: replay only the artifact's exact source-bound five cohorts; new inputs require new evidence
known_reuse: original COCO bank and source groups previously used in multimodal pairing/model-comparison work
legacy_role_warning: future_1/future_2/ood are API slot names only; actual roles are dev/testA/testB
metrics: within-role target retrieval R@1 with8 targets
objectives: MSE + 0.1*(1-cosine); only train provides gradients; calibration does not choose hyperparameters
outcome_policy: retain all3seeds and all arms; no resampling, early stopping, thresholds or tuning from evaluation results

recipe.image: EXIF-oriented RGB; bilinear 16x16 resize; row-major sixteen 4x4x3 patches in slots 0..15
recipe.image_channels: RGB/127.5-1 in 0..47; modality +1 at 48; grid x,y normalized to [-1,1] at 49,50
recipe.presence: channel 63 is one for present slots; absent slots all zero; student attention masks absent slots
recipe.selection: sort each original split by SHA256('hepta-shared-tiny-v1:'+decimal image_id); first 8, test first16 split8+8
recipe.targets: concatenate separately encoded real EG2 image-global[768], text-global[768]; width 1536
recipe.text: caption UTF-8 first 256 bytes; sixteen 16-byte chunks in slots 16..31
recipe.text_channels: byte/127.5-1 in 0..15; valid-byte flags in 16..31; modality -1 at 48; chunk position at 49

student.backbone: one TransformerEncoder layer, width64, heads4, FF128, dropout0
student.initialization: new random student, identical seed initial weights across input controls
student.optimizer: stock SGD, no momentum or state, gradient norm clipped at1

teacher.targets: concatenate separately encoded real EG2 image-global[768], text-global[768]; width 1536
